# 🚀 Pull Request Checklist (Definition of Done)

## ✅ General Requirements

- [ ] PR title follows the **convention** (e.g., `PROJECT-123: Feature Description`).
- [ ] PR contains **only necessary changes** (no unrelated refactoring or debug logs).
- [ ] All **merge conflicts are resolved**.

## 🧹 Code Quality & Best Practices

- [ ] Code follows **Clean Code principles** (readable, maintainable, no hard-coded values).
- [ ] No **console logs** or **debugging code** left in.
- [ ] Code follows **team coding standards** (naming conventions, linting, etc.).

## 🧪 Testing & Validation

- [ ] New feature **works as expected** (manual testing completed).
- [ ] Edge cases are **considered and handled** (e.g., invalid inputs, error states).
- [ ] No **breaking changes** for existing functionality.
